Name: Core Fanbase
Description: The regulars. Each point gives every Core Fanbase viewer a 20% chance to score twice when the stream ends (80% at 4 points). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Staff
Description: The people the stream pays. Each point gives every Staff viewer a 30% chance to waive their Cash cost each time they're scored (90% at 9 points). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Content
Description: Each point gives every viewer outside the Core Fanbase a 30% chance to score twice when the stream ends (90% at 3 points). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Boomers
Description: Old money, old opinions. Each point makes Sub Cap upgrades 1 Cash cheaper in your next shop. After a scored stream, each Boomer in chat has a 10% chance to log off for good (they leave your Audience). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Millennials
Description: Very online, waiting on the inheritance. Each time a Boomer leaves your Audience, a random Millennial you own earns +1 Cash for good, once per point (at least once). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Gen-Z
Description: Start weak, grow fast. After a scored stream, each Gen-Z viewer in chat gains +1 Clout or +1 Cash for good (at random), once per point (up to 2). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Gatekeepers
Description: Nobody gets in. Each point gives one more use of a Gatekeeper's removal action this stream (the extra uses are shared). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Hype Men
Description: They bring friends. If the server goes down (chat over the Sub Cap), each point gives a 10% chance the stream still scores (20% at 2 points). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Troll Army
Description: If the stream gets deplatformed (Deplatform Risk over the limit), each point pays 1 random Clout or Cash. Not if you end the stream or the server goes down. (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Mods
Description: Keeping it civil. When the stream is scored, each point gives a 10% chance that your next stream starts with 1 Deplatform Risk cancelled (20% at 2 points). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Full Stream
Description: Packed house. Bonuses that need a full chat count chat as full with up to 1 empty space per point (up to 3). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Marketers
Description: They know who to call. Each point gives one more use of a Marketer's recruit action this stream (the extra uses are shared). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Voyeurs
Description: Always watching. Each point gives one more use of a Voyeur's peek action this stream (up to 1, shared). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Shop Control
Description: Friends in the shop. When the stream is scored, each point makes your first recruit in the next shop cost 1 Clout less (up to 5). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Saboteurs
Description: Multiplayer. When the stream is scored, each point makes every rival's next recruit cost 1 Clout more (up to 5). (Scores from 2 different viewers in chat: 2 = 1 point, 3 = 2 points...)

Name: Techspertise
Description: If the server goes down, the stream may still score: 20% / 40% / 50% at 1 / 2 / 3 points (3 is the most that counts).

Name: Finance Bros
Description: Each point gives every viewer a 10% chance to score their Cash reward twice (90% at 9 points).

Name: Doomsdayers
Description: Multiplayer. After your successful stream, each point gives every viewer in your rivals' next stream a 4% chance to score nothing (20% at 5 points).

Name: Zoomer
Description: Chaotic. When the stream is scored, two separate rolls, each with a 20% chance per point (80% at 4 points): +6 Clout, and -3 Cash.

Name: Armchair Activists
Description: All talk. Each point gives every Armchair Activist in chat a 10% chance to score nothing when the stream ends (50% at 5 points). Other viewers aren't affected.

Name: Clout
Description: Everyone wants a piece. Each viewer outside the Core Fanbase has a 10% chance per point (40% at 4 points) to bring +1 Clout more, every time they score.

Name: Memetics Division
Description: Reposted forever. Each point gives a 1% chance (10% at 10 points) that the whole stream scores a second time: every viewer and every community reward, all rolled again.

Name: Bots
Description: Multiplayer. When your stream is scored, each Bots viewer in chat has a 10% chance per point (40% at 4 points) to send a Bot into the next player's next stream. A Bot takes a space in chat and earns nothing.
